name: What steps are involved in the bathroom accessibility remodeling process?

mainEntity.name: What steps are involved in the bathroom accessibility remodeling process?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process begins with an on-site consultation where Abraham Becerra assesses your layout, doorway clearance, and existing plumbing to identify practical solutions. Next, plans are established for fixture placements, tile preferences, and any required framing changes. During construction, the crew handles demolition, installs structural wood blocking inside the wall cavities for grab bars, and coordinates licensed trades for drain and electrical moves. Finally, the team completes drywall, waterproofing, slip-resistant tile setting, finish carpentry, and plumbing trim installation before conducting a final walkthrough to confirm safe functionality.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes an on-site assessment, framing modifications with wall blocking, rough-in plumbing and electrical coordination, custom tile and trim installation, and a final walkthrough.
